purpose: Recover the order in which current voice/GWT/perception coupling was introduced and repaired, so current Frankenstein source is not misread as a single monolithic design event.
evidence_boundary: Git commit content/messages establish source chronology and developer-reported tests/results; they are not independent reexecution in this Triggerwort-5 run.

chronology.forensic_interpretation: First verified accessible current-repo appearance of the voice cognitive loop found by this run.

chronology.event: Arbitration formula replaced by authoritative Phase-43 reference and Shadow Mode added
mechanisms: Shadow Mode prevents unsolicited speech despite scoring
chronology.failure_pressure: self-derived scoring needed alignment with external authoritative reference; initiative needed safe calibration mode

chronology.event: Realtime-to-stern subprocess path replaced with in-process dispatch
mechanisms: in-process stern dispatch while audio stream active
chronology.failure_pressure: fork+exec from process with live PortAudio background thread intermittently hung for 15-20+ seconds
chronology.reusable_rule: Avoid fork/subprocess control-plane calls from latency-sensitive processes that own live audio threads when an in-process deterministic dispatch exists.

chronology.event: Stale calibration reference threshold corrected from 0.58 to 0.86
chronology.failure_pressure: reference/config drift could cause future ports to reintroduce a known production threshold bug
chronology.reusable_rule: Reference fixtures and live configuration must not encode conflicting policy constants.

chronology.event: WAIT telemetry corrected to record strongest real candidate score instead of constant threshold
chronology.failure_pressure: constant WAIT score erased the distribution needed for threshold calibration
chronology.reusable_rule: A reject/WAIT outcome must preserve decision margin/evidence, not only the threshold that rejected it.

chronology.event: Visual Cortex spec pre-registered before implementation landed
chronology.forensic_interpretation: Useful temporal boundary: some intended architecture is documented before code and must not be back-promoted to implemented status at this commit.

failure_pressure: WAIT winner was incorrectly conflated with unknown visual content
substring person matching failed negation and matched man inside woman
chronology.reusable_rule: Separate content interpretation from interruption/arbitration decision; semantic keyword detectors require explicit negation and token-boundary handling.

mechanisms: USER_BUSY category exists but no generator at that point
person presence still caption keyword based
chronology.reusable_rule: Defined enum/category is not evidence that its producer or causal path exists.

chronology.event: Temporal L1 cortex/local presence/USER_BUSY fusion introduced; voice user_present became overridable but live call-site remained unwired
chronology.reported_measurement: forced-divergence test reported presence/busy disagreement on 20/32 ticks
chronology.forensic_interpretation: This is a source-ready intermediate state, not yet the live voice coupling.

chronology.event: Presence/interruptibility wired into the actual realtime voice call-site
reported_behavior: empty room forced WAIT despite high-scored candidate
busy signal raised interruption cost and flipped SPEAK to WAIT
presence return caused re-evaluation instead of permanent freeze
chronology.reusable_rule: A control variable only earns integration credit when the live decision call-site consumes it and downstream behavior changes.

chronology.event: Typed PerceptualField + GWT causal boundary introduced
reported_measurements: correct VisualNeed route ~0.03ms versus baseline ~14.6s and shuffled ~14.7s
chronology.failure_pressure: question-text fallback initially defeated the shuffled-control condition, so target_heads became authoritative when supplied
chronology.reusable_rule: A causal control must be unable to recover treatment identity through an uncontrolled correlated feature.

chronology.event: Previously built visual stack connected to a persistent live cortex loop
mechanisms: cortex loop embedded in existing approved conversation daemon
reported_measurements: ~32% of one core at 1Hz versus ~58% at 2Hz
chronology.failure_pressure: P0-P5 components existed and tested but were idle outside CLI/manual invocation; separate process would collide with camera ownership
chronology.reusable_rule: Source-ready component trees do not earn system-function credit until an actual scheduler/live caller reaches them; shared resource ownership can constrain process topology.

chronology.event: VoiceSessionCapsule added as compact in-memory session projection
chronology.reusable_rule: Dense live-session projections may be useful, but must refresh from canonical sources and must not become a second durable voice-memory authority.

derived_architecture_lineage.main_conclusion: The current architecture is best understood as an error-driven coupling sequence: isolated useful mechanisms repeatedly became system mechanisms only after explicit live wiring, resource ownership, telemetry and causal-control bugs were discovered and repaired.

grid10_frankenstein2_implications.rule: Do not give a GRID10 function credit merely because a cell/module implementation exists.
grid10_frankenstein2_implications.required_receipt: scheduler/caller -> input state -> cell uptake -> downstream decision/state change -> outcome/re-entry

grid10_frankenstein2_implications.rule: Keep a single shared competition/arbitration ABI where modalities compete under comparable gates; modality-specific features may differ but duplicate policy formulas should require evidence.
Presence, busy/interruptibility and identity are distinct variables. Presence can be known while identity remains UNKNOWN; busy must not be a renamed motion/presence signal.
Causal tests must defeat side channels: a shuffled/lesioned treatment cannot retain identifying text/metadata that lets routing reconstruct the original condition.
Permanent loops need explicit resource ownership and scheduler evidence; component unit tests alone are insufficient.
WAIT/reject telemetry must record distance/margin from decision boundary to remain calibratable.

next_exact_gate: Resolve equivalent chronology for stern.py consolidation/effect path and historical Project-Frankenstein predecessors, then merge only edge metadata whose first/last commit windows are source-supported.
